text:
ana: Heads-up — prepping new org 'eu-ml-prod' for customer X. Need GPU + network preflight across AWS/GCP. Quick checklist run-through?
sam: Can you list regions + target instance types and expected throughput?
ana: Targets: GCP europe-west4 (A100 80GB targets), AWS eu-central-1 (P4d/P4de family). Baseline 50 concurrent inference workers, ~200 peak. Need ENIs, EIPs, NAT throughput, route tables.
mike: Note: eu-central1 has reported on-demand shortages for P4 family next 30 days. Plan B = eu-west-1 or reserved/dedicated capacity. ENI limits per instance family will bite at scale.
olivia: Tagging & billing: project = redwood-eu-ml-prod, billing acct = redwood-enterprise-eu, tags: env=prod, owner=ml-platform, cost_center=eng-infra. IAM groups: infra-gpu-admins, infra-network-ops.
ana: IAM details: service accounts needed: inference-runner-sa, metrics-exporter-sa. KMS key in eu region, HSM optional. Need key rotation policy.
infra-bot: Quota snapshot (automated): GCP europe-west4 A100 quota = 0, GCP ticket #12345 pending; AWS EC2 P4d quota eu-central = 2 (soft limit). ENI per-subnet default = 30.
sam: If GCP quota=0 we must request A100 quota with forecasting justification. Draft justification: "We require 8 A100 GPUs over next 3 months to support 50–200 concurrent inference endpoints with average 2k tokens/sec per worker."
julia: I'll file the GCP support request and push AWS limit increase today. For AWS, request increases for: P4d family, Elastic Network Interfaces, and Elastic IPs (EIP) separately.
mike: Also check subnet IP capacity — we need contiguous IPs across AZs. Recommend 2x NAT gateways per AZ for redundancy and throughput.
nana: Cost callout: on-demand P4d run at scale ≈ $120k/mo. Recommend negotiation for 6-month reserved commit or Redwood Dedicated option to save ~25–35%.
olivia: Preflight checklist to include: 1) Open quota tickets with numeric justification + expected timeline; 2) Create IAM groups & SAs; 3) Provision KMS key + rotation policy; 4) Confirm subnet IPs/AZ spread; 5) NAT gateway sizing; 6) Cost estimate + reserved/dedicated proposal; 7) Tagging/billing mapping; 8) Fallback region plan.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll own GCP ticket. @julia take AWS. @mike do subnet IP calc and cost model. @olivia set up billing tags and infra groups.
nana: Command snippets for checks: ```gcloud compute regions describe europe-west4 --project=redwood-eu-ml-prod``` and ```aws ec2 describe-account-attributes --attribute-names max-instances```
julia: AWS notes — also request increase for "VPC Elastic IPs" and check default security group rules (some customers require locked-down egress). File will include required contact person + business justification.
mike: I'll run a quick capacity simulation (IP per AZ, ENI headroom, concurrency) and share numbers by EOD.
nana: Thanks — I'll update the runbook with final numbers and post link when done: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/account-preflight-eu-ml-prod :eyes:
